package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"

	ws "example.com/blog/lyr_gen/decl/components/ws"
	_ "example.com/blog/lyr_gen/impl/components/ws"
	"github.com/orbit-z/lyr"
)

func main() {
	for _, p := range []ws.Props{{Kind: "a", N: 1}, {Kind: "b", N: 7}} {
		var buf bytes.Buffer
		if err := ws.Render(&lyr.Ctx{}, lyr.NewWriter(&buf), p, lyr.Slots{}); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		fmt.Printf("%q\n", buf.String())
	}
}
